privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.header_desc: We are strongly committed to protecting your privacy and providing transparent information about how we collect, use, and share your personal information. Last updated: February 10th, 2025
privacy_policy.last_updated: Last updated: February 10th, 2025. We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.p1: Welcome to the <important>Clande</important> website (the "legal frame"). This Privacy Policy outlines the personal information practices...
intro.p2: This Privacy Policy describes the types of personal information we collect from you and how we use, share, and protect it. We are committed to protecting your privacy and being transparent about our data processing activities.

collection.title: Data Collection
collection.desc: We collect information about you directly from you and automatically through your use of our Products, as well as from third parties.
collection.direct_title: Information we collect directly from you:
items: Your name, email address, phone number, and other contact information
Account credentials, such as your username and password
Payment information when you make a purchase
collection.footer: Types of information we use: names, contact info (such email, address, phone number), demographic details (location, interests, and preferences), technical data (browser type, IP address, device, cookie data), usage information, and files and content you provide to us. If we collect sensitive or special categories of data from you, we will always inform you and obtain your consent where required.

usage.title: Use of Data
usage.desc: We use the data we collect about you for:
items: Providing and personalizing our products and services to you, including any tailored features or content
Processing payments and completing your requested transactions
Sending you important information about the Products or service updates
Communicating with you about your account or responding to your inquiries
Marketing and promotional communications (with your consent where required)
Improving, customizing, and developing our Products
Conducting analytics and research about how you use the Products
Ensuring the safety, integrity, and security of our systems and our products

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking
cookies.desc: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to collect information about you for various purposes. These technologies help us to provide and improve our services, understand user behavior, and provide you with a more personalized experience.
cookies.essential_desc: These cookies are required for you to access our website and features and use its functionalities. Essential cookies cannot be disabled or turned off, as the site is dependent upon them.
cookies.performance_desc: These cookies collect information about how you use our website so we can improve it. For instance, performance cookies tell us which pages are most frequently visited, help us record difficulties you may have with the site, and show us whether our advertising is effective or not.

third_party.title: Third party Services
third_party.desc: We may use trusted third-party service providers to enhance your experience on our platform. These service providers may have access to your personal information only to perform their services on our behalf.
items: Payment processors to facilitate secure payment transactions
Analytics providers to help us improve our services
Customer support platforms for efficient communication
Cloud hosting services for data storage and processing
Marketing platforms for sending newsletters and promotions (with your consent)
third_party.footer: We require such third parties with which we share your personal information to provide an equivalent level of protection of your personal information as we do.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.desc: You have the following rights regarding your personal information:
rights.footer: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the contact information provided in the Contact Us section below.

access.title: Access
access.desc: Request a copy of the personal information we hold about you.

correction.title: Correction
correction.desc: Request that we correct any inaccurate or incomplete personal information.

deletion.title: Deletion
deletion.desc: Request that we delete your personal information, subject to certain exceptions.

objection.title: Objection
objection.desc: Object to our processing of your personal information for certain purposes.

portability.title: Data Portability
portability.desc: Request a copy of your personal information in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.desc: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy policy or our privacy practices, please contact us at:
